# Harmony

> > Harmony is a medical supply distributor specializing in disposable gloves and protective equipment for healthcare professionals.

Harmony offers a comprehensive selection of medical-grade disposable gloves from leading manufacturers including Kimberly-Clark, Medline, and Curad. The company focuses on providing chemotherapy-rated and specialty nitrile exam gloves for clinical and healthcare settings.

## Key Topics

- Disposable gloves
- Nitrile exam gloves
- Chemotherapy-rated gloves
- Medical exam gloves
- Kimberly-Clark
- Medline
- Curad
- Extended cuff gloves
- Sterile gloves
- Purple Nitrile Medical Gloves
- Restore Sense gloves
- AloeTouch Ice gloves
- Healthcare protective equipment
